description: This file defines the UseTokenParser class, which is part of Twig's internal implementation for parsing 'use' statements in Twig templates. It handles importing blocks from other templates into the current template, facilitating template reuse.

classes.name: UseTokenParser
classes.description: A token parser class responsible for parsing the 'use' tag in Twig templates, allowing template blocks to be imported from another template.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'use' tag in Twig templates, extracting the referenced template and optional target block aliases, then registers the imported blocks for reuse.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name that this parser handles, which is 'use'.
